ai.title: AI and go-to-market

stories.h: ChatGPT Enterprise is now sold through AWS Marketplace on existing AWS bills
Anthropic’s amended IPO filing prices 825m shares at $70 to $78 each
Nonprofits sue OpenAI, Google, Anthropic and Meta to halt frontier AI work

tactics: Open with a recent change at the account, like a new hire or raise. Not your product.
Ask AI for a prospect’s three likely pains. Lead with the one you can solve.
Let AI draft, never send. Rewrite the first line so it sounds like you.
Give every deal a clear “why now”. No why now, no forecast.
Send the call recap within 10 minutes. Speed beats polish.
Prospect only where three or more traits match your best recent wins.
Have a second named contact in every deal by the second meeting.
tips: Pick partners who already own the customer relationship, not the biggest logos.
Land one co-sold deal with a new partner inside 90 days.
Keep deal registration under five minutes or partners stop doing it.
Track partner-sourced pipeline, not just partner-influenced.
